name: Kegelee
subtitle: Kegel & Pelvic Floor Trainer
promotionalText: Build a daily pelvic floor routine with guided sessions, five difficulty levels, reminders and clear progress tracking.
description:
Make pelvic floor training part of your day. Kegelee guides you through short Kegel exercise routines, helps you build a consistent habit and keeps your progress in one place.

FOLLOW A CLEAR RHYTHM
The animated training circle guides each contraction, hold and relaxation phase. Follow the on-screen cues and pause your session whenever you need a break.

TRAIN AT YOUR LEVEL
Build your routine across five difficulty levels, with varied exercise patterns and guided rest periods. Give feedback after your session to adjust the challenge as you progress.

LEARN THE BASICS
Work through interactive lessons that introduce pelvic floor training, explain how to find the muscles and guide your first exercise.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Review completed training days, workout history, streaks and endurance measurements. Your training calendar helps you see the habit you are building.

MAKE TIME FOR YOUR ROUTINE
Choose reminder times that fit your day. Switch between light and dark themes and use the app in your preferred supported language.

KEEP YOUR PROGRESS CONNECTED
Create an account to sync your training progress across your devices. Progress is stored locally and synced with your account when connected.

FREE TRAINING AND PREMIUM ACCESS
Start with the free training content. Kegelee Premium unlocks the full training experience through monthly, three-month or yearly auto-renewable subscriptions. Eligible new subscribers can try Premium with a three-day free trial. Prices and trial eligibility are shown in the app before purchase.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase or after any eligible free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.

Kegelee is a fitness and educational tool and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
